Market today: The mood is cautious, with inflation fears and rising prices for shoppers being the real drivers. This impacts consumer discretionary and could spill into tech.

Your holdings: SMCI (-46.17%), SOXL (-84.06%), and MUU (-71.11%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader market sentiment and any further news on consumer spending.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions.
plays: Trim SMCI: Consider reducing exposure given the significant drawdown.
Trim SOXL: Evaluate further reductions due to the extreme losses.
Trim MUU: Assess the possibility of cutting losses on this highly leveraged position.
